jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Distributed Caching
jobs.content:
About the Role

Cloudflare is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to build our edge caching layer. You will work with Rust, Go, and Python across global data centers.

What you will do:

  • Design distributed caching services
  • Optimize edge packet throughput
  • Maintain high-availability infrastructure

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience with distributed systems
  • Proficiency in Rust or Go
  • Deep understanding of HTTP, TCP, and DNS

Salary range: $160,000 - $210,000 per year
